name: Shiftbound
desc: A tiny two-world platformer: run and jump through 3 levels while pressing SHIFT to flip between two parallel worlds — platforms and hazards only exist in one world at a time, so the way forward is always in the other world. Chain jumps up to 5 in a row, each one stronger than the last, so any step can be climbed. Made for GitHub Game Off 2026 (theme: SHIFT); Canvas 2D, no engine, no dependencies.
controls: Arrows or A/D move, Up/W/Z jump (press again mid-air to chain jumps, up to 5), Shift/Space/X flips between the two worlds, R restarts the level
creator: kiki347zz
